🌿 Deep Cleansing Power

Effectively removes impurities, excess oil, and makeup without stripping your skin’s natural moisture. This gentle yet thorough cleansing action refreshes your complexion, preparing it for optimal hydration and nourishment.

Enriched with rose essential oil, this cleanser provides deep hydration and locks in moisture, leaving your skin feeling soft, smooth, and glowing with a healthy radiance throughout the day.


✨ Youthful Glow & Pore Refinement

Formulated with jojoba seed oil and cucumber extract, it helps regulate sebum production and tightens pores. This combination supports a clearer, more refined complexion, reducing the appearance of large pores and promoting youthful skin.

The natural soothing properties of jasmine and rose essential oils help calm redness and irritation, making it ideal for sensitive skin. Regular use promotes balanced skin tone and reduces discomfort caused by inflammation.

With consistent use, this cleanser helps reduce marks, uneven pigmentation, and dullness, revealing a brighter, revitalized, and more even-toned complexion that glows with health.
